text_en: But a man named Ananias, with the consent of his wife Sapphira, sold a piece of property;
text_cn: 有一个人，名叫阿纳尼雅，同他的妻子撒斐辣卖了一块田地。

text_en: with his wife’s knowledge, he kept back some of the proceeds, and brought only a part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
text_cn: 他扣留了一部分价钱，妻子也表同意，就带了一部份去放在宗徒脚前。

text_en: “Ananias, ” Peter asked, “why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the proceeds of the land?
text_cn: 伯多禄说道：“阿纳尼雅！为什么撒殚充满了你的心，使你欺骗圣神，扣留了田地的价钱呢？

text_en: While it remained unsold, did it not remain your own? And after it was sold, were not the proceeds at your disposal? How is it that you have contrived this deed in your heart? You did not lie to us but to God! ”
text_cn: 田地留下不卖，不是还是你的吗？既卖了，价钱不是还属于你权下吗？为什么你心中打算了这事？你不是欺骗人，而是欺骗天主！”

text_en: Now when Ananias heard these words, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard of it.
text_cn: 阿纳尼雅一听这话，就跌倒断了气。凡听见的人，都十分害怕。

text_en: The young men came and wrapped up his body, then carried him out and buried him.
text_cn: 年轻人就起来，把他裹起，抬去埋葬了。

text_en: After an interval of about three hours his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
text_cn: 大约隔了三个时辰，他的妻子进来了，还不知所发生的事。

text_en: Peter said to her, “Tell me whether you and your husband sold the land for such and such a price. ” And she said, “Yes, that was the price. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄问她说：“你告诉我：你们卖田地的价钱就是这么多吗？”她说：“是，就是这么多。”

text_en: Then Peter said to her, “How is it that you have agreed together to put the Spirit of the Lord to the test? Look, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄便说：“你们为什么共谋试探主的神呢？看，埋葬你丈夫者的脚已到门口，他们也要把你抬去。”

text_en: Immediately she fell down at his feet and died. When the young men came in they found her dead, so they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
text_cn: 她立刻跌倒在他脚前，也断了气。年轻人进来，见她死了，就抬去埋葬在她丈夫旁边。

text_en: And great fear seized the whole church and all who heard of these things.
text_cn: 全教会和一切听见这些事的人，都十分害怕。

text_en: Now many signs and wonders were done among the people through the apostles. And they were all together in Solomon’s Portico.
text_cn: 宗徒们在百姓中行了许多征兆，显了许多奇迹。众信徒都同心合意地聚在撒罗满廊下，

text_en: None of the rest dared to join them, but the people held them in high esteem.
text_cn: 其他的人没有一个敢与他们接近的；但是百姓都夸赞他们。

text_en: Yet more than ever believers were added to the Lord, great numbers of both men and women,
text_cn: 信主的人越来越增加，男女的人数极其众多。

text_en: so that they even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on cots and mats, in order that Peter’s shadow might fall on some of them as he came by.
text_cn: 宗徒们行了这样多的奇迹，以致有人把病人抬到街上，放在床上或褥子上，好叫伯多禄走过的时候，至少他的影子能遮在一些人身上。

text_en: A great number of people would also gather from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing the sick and those tormented by unclean spirits, and they were all cured.
text_cn: 还有许多耶路撒冷四周城市的人，抬着病人和被邪魔所缠扰的人，齐集而来，他们都得了痊愈。

text_en: Then the high priest took action; he and all who were with him (that is, the sect of the Sadducees), being filled with jealousy,
text_cn: 大司祭和他的一切同人，即撒杜塞党人，都起来，嫉恨填胸，

text_en: arrested the apostles and put them in the public prison.
text_cn: 下手拿住宗徒，把他们押在公共拘留所内。

text_en: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors, brought them out, and said,
text_cn: 夜间，有上主的天使打开了监狱的门，领他们出来说：

text_en: “Go, stand in the temple and tell the people the whole message about this life. ”
text_cn: “你们去，站在圣殿里，把一切有关生命的话，讲给百姓听。”

text_en: When they heard this, they entered the temple at daybreak and went on with their teaching. When the high priest and those with him arrived, they called together the council and the whole body of the elders of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
text_cn: 他们领了命，天一亮就进入圣殿施教。大司祭和他的同人来召开公议会，即以色列子民全长老议会，差人去监里把宗徒们提出来。

text_en: But when the temple police went there, they did not find them in the prison; so they returned and reported,
text_cn: 差役来到，在监狱中没有找到他们，便回去报告，

text_en: “We found the prison securely locked and the guards standing at the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside. ”
text_cn: 说：“我们确实看见监狱关锁的非常牢固，卫兵也站在门前，但一打开，里面没有找到一个人。”

text_en: Now when the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were perplexed about them, wondering what might be going on.
text_cn: 圣殿警官和司祭长一听这些话，十分纳闷，不知发生了什么事。

text_en: Then someone arrived and announced, “Look, the men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people! ”
text_cn: 忽有一个人来向他们报告说：“看，你们押在监狱里的人，站在圣殿里，教训百姓。”

text_en: Then the captain went with the temple police and brought them, but without violence, for they were afraid of being stoned by the people.
text_cn: 圣殿警官就同差役去把他们领来，但未用武力，因为怕百姓用石头砸他们。

text_en: When they had brought them, they had them stand before the council. The high priest questioned them,
text_cn: 他们把宗徒领来之后，叫他们站在公议会中，大司祭便审问他们，

text_en: saying, “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name, yet here you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and you are determined to bring this man’s blood on us. ”
text_cn: 说：“我们曾严厉命令你们，不可用这名字施教。你们看，你们却把你们的道理传遍了耶路撒冷，你们是有意把这人的血，引到我们身上来啊！”

text_en: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than any human authority.
text_cn: 伯多禄和宗徒们回答说：“听天主的命应胜过听人的命。

text_en: The God of our ancestors raised up Jesus, whom you had killed by hanging him on a tree.
text_cn: 我们祖先的天主复活了你们下毒手悬在木架上的耶稣。

text_en: God exalted him at his right hand as Leader and Savior that he might give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.
text_cn: 天主以右手举扬了他，叫他做首领和救主，为赐给以色列人悔改和罪赦。

text_en: And we are witnesses to these things, and so is the Holy Spirit whom God has given to those who obey him. ”
text_cn: 我们就是这些事的证人，并且天主给那些服从他的人所赏的圣神，也为此事作证。”

text_en: When they heard this, they were enraged and wanted to kill them.
text_cn: 他们一听这话，大发雷霆，想要杀害他们。

text_en: But a Pharisee in the council named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, respected by all the people, stood up and ordered the men to be put outside for a short time.
text_cn: 有一个法利塞人，名叫加玛里耳，是众百姓敬重的法学士， 他在公议会中站起来，命这些人暂时出去。

text_en: Then he said to them, “Fellow Israelites, consider carefully what you propose to do to these men.
text_cn: 他便向议员们说：“诸位以色列人！你们对这些人，应小心处理！

text_en: For some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and a number of men, about four hundred, joined him; but he was killed, and all who followed him were dispersed and disappeared.
text_cn: 因为在不久以前，特乌达起来，说自己是个大人物，附和他的人数约有四百；他被杀了，跟从他的人也都散了，归于乌有。

text_en: After him Judas the Galilean rose up at the time of the census and got people to follow him; he also perished, and all who followed him were scattered.
text_cn: 此后，加里肋亚人犹达，当户口登记的日子，起来引诱百姓随从他；他丧亡了，跟从他的人也都四散了。

text_en: So in the present case, I tell you, keep away from these men and let them alone; because if this plan or this undertaking is of human origin, it will fail;
text_cn: 对现今的事，我奉劝你们：不要管这些人，由他们去罢！因为，若是这计划或工作是由人来的，必要消散；

text_en: but if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow them—in that case you may even be found fighting against God! ” They were convinced by him,
text_cn: 但若是从天主来的，你们不但不能消灭他们，恐怕你们反而成了与天主作对的人。”他们都赞成他的意见。

text_en: and when they had called in the apostles, they had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
text_cn: 他们遂把宗徒们叫来，鞭打了以后，命他们不可再因耶稣的名字讲道，遂释放了他们。

text_en: As they left the council, they rejoiced that they were considered worthy to suffer dishonor for the sake of the name.
text_cn: 他们喜喜欢欢地由公议会前出来，因为他们配为这名字受侮辱。

text_en: And every day in the temple and at home they did not cease to teach and proclaim Jesus as the Messiah.
text_cn: 他们每天不断在圣殿内，或挨户施教，宣讲基督耶稣的福音。
